note: ADR 0454: a call in the parameter list of a closure runs only when the closure is called without the argument. Four helpers build a closure whose default calls the callback and never call it, one calls it with the argument and an anonymous forEach callback is supplied its index: rc.17 runs no default and throws nothing (counters stay 0). The checker made SC2001 violations of them; they are uncertifiable. CalledOmitted runs the default in the memo: the dev REACTIVE_WRITE_IN_OWNED_SCOPE diagnostic is covered by an uncertifiable result (ADR 0452 known miss).
